lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: How might a military veteran with Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) react to a sudden traffic stop?

options.text: May experience severe hypervigilance, rapid heart rate, anxiety, and panic response
Will immediately lose physical conscious awareness and enter deep sleep state
Exhibits complete physical immunity from roadside field sobriety testing checks
Is legally exempt from following all Texas municipal parking regulations
